text: 近期，北交所上市公司股份回购及股东增持动作明显升温。据不完全统计，截至7月24日晚，7月已有十余家公司披露股份回购或重要股东增持计划。从实际控制人、董监高到持股5%以上股东，多方主体披露增持意向；从自有资金到银行专项贷款，资金来源渠道持续拓宽。（上证报）
text_en: Recently, share buybacks and shareholder stake increases at Beijing Stock Exchange listed companies have notably heated up. As of July 24 evening, over ten companies disclosed buyback or major shareholder increase plans this month. From controllers and executives to 5%+ shareholders, multiple parties disclosed increase intentions; from proprietary funds to bank special loans, funding channels continue expanding.
